title: Session List
summary: Keeps the current device safe while cleaning up sessions: it's pinned and marked, excluded from "sign out all others", and confirmed inline.
description: Signed-in sessions list with this device pinned and marked, "Sign out all others" that never includes it, an inline confirm (Cancel focused) before signing out here, and sessions from another country flagged with "approximate location" wording.
catches: Signing out the current device by accident (inline confirm, Cancel focused)
"Sign out all others" including this device (it never does)
Sessions from a different country than this device
Location shown as approximate, not exact
limits: Country comparison uses the IP-derived location you pass, which can be wrong (VPNs, mobile carriers)
Does not revoke sessions itself; your callbacks do
a11y: Section labelled by its title; rows set aria-busy while revoking
Inline confirm is a labelled group; Cancel gets focus, Escape closes and focus returns
Revoke buttons include sr-only device and location
Outcome announced in a polite live region
server: Revoke sessions server-side and never trust a client flag for which session is current.
stops: Signed out own device by mistake
mistakes: sign out all logged me out
cant tell which session is mine
